en.headline: Hong Kong arts figures pay tribute to Yayoi Kusama after death at 97
en.dek: West Kowloon Cultural District Authority board chairman Bernard Chan and local design studio AllRightsReserved were among those expressing sadness following confirmation of the Japanese artist’s death.
body: Hong Kong cultural figures and fans paid tribute on Thursday after Japanese avant-garde artist Yayoi Kusama’s death at 97 was confirmed. Her studio and Tokyo’s Yayoi Kusama Museum announced she died on 14 August in a Tokyo hospital from multiple organ failure.

West Kowloon Cultural District Authority board chairman Bernard Chan recalled the M+ museum’s major retrospective “Yayoi Kusama: 1945 to Now”, which ran from November 2022 to May 2023 and drew more than 280,000 visitors. Chan said a moment he would “treasure forever” was travelling to Tokyo in March 2023 to thank her in person.

Local design studio AllRightsReserved also expressed sadness. A permanent outdoor Pumpkin sculpture by Kusama stands at SOGO Kai Tak, and Sotheby’s recently staged a retrospective of her work in Hong Kong. The M+ show remains the largest retrospective of her work in Asia outside Japan.

zh.headline: 香港藝文界悼念草間彌生辭世 西九主席陳智思感懷
zh.dek: 西九文化區管理局董事局主席陳智思及本地設計工作室AllRightsReserved等周四就日本前衛藝術家草間彌生辭世表達哀思。
body: 日本前衛藝術家草間彌生離世的消息周四獲確認後，香港藝文界及粉絲紛紛悼念。草間彌生工作室及東京草間彌生美術館公布，她於8月14日在東京醫院因多器官衰竭去世，享年97歲。
西九文化區管理局董事局主席陳智思提到M+博物館2022年11月至2023年5月舉行的大型回顧展「草間彌生：1945至今」，吸引逾28萬人次參觀。陳智思表示，2023年3月親身前往東京感謝她是畢生難忘的時刻。
本地設計工作室AllRightsReserved亦表達哀思。草間彌生的南瓜雕塑永久陳列於SOGO啟德，蘇富比近期亦在港舉行其作品回顧展。M+的展覽是日本以外亞洲規模最大的草間彌生回顧展。
